Name: Buyable Dinosaurs and Ostriches
Author: weissnicht01
Description:
Always wanted to have some Ostriches at the start of the game? Tired of hatching eggs on your own? Then this mod is right for you!

_____________

Marnie now sells Dinosaurs and Ostriches.
By default, Dinosaurs are buyable after donating 40 items to the museum and Ostriches and their incubator are buyable after you've visited Ginger Island for the first time.

However, you can change these settings in the following ways:
Ostriches: always = always, island = after you've visited the island for the first time, quest= after Professor Snail gives you the incubator recipe, never = never
Dinosaur: you can chose between always, never, and museum donations. You can specify how many donations you need to unlock them if you chose that option.
Incubators and the recipes are buyable after you've unlocked ostriches (via their settings) when their setting is enabled.


You can make these changes in the config file or  in-game with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]

_____________

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Requires game version 1.6
